__broaden__.ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king') · 'of the king', owner after an anticipating suffix (ኅይስናሁ ለንጉሥ 'the worth of the king')
